dialogue_transcript.content: Over the past two weeks, have you felt little interest or pleasure in doing things?
No, I have not felt a lack of interest or pleasure. I still enjoy traveling, trying new cuisines, and visiting historical sites.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless?
No, I have not felt down, depressed, or hopeless over the past two weeks. I am doing fine and enjoying my travels and historical interests.
Over the past two weeks, have you had trouble falling or staying asleep?
No, I have not had any trouble falling or staying asleep over the past two weeks. My sleep has been restful and uninterrupted during this time.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt tired or lacked energy?
No, I have not felt tired or lacked energy over the past two weeks. I have been feeling fine and maintaining my usual activity levels.
Over the past two weeks, have you had a poor appetite or been overeating?
No, my appetite has been normal over the past two weeks. I haven't experienced any changes in eating habits or weight.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt bad about yourself or like a failure?
No, I haven't felt bad about myself or like a failure over the past two weeks. I feel content with my life and my travels.
Over the past two weeks, have you had trouble concentrating on tasks like reading or working?
No, I haven't had trouble concentrating on tasks like reading or working over the past two weeks. My mind has been clear, even when recalling travel memories.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt slowed down in your movements or speech?
No, I haven't felt slowed down in my movements or speech over the past two weeks. I've been moving and talking at my usual pace.
